display_title: HORIZON-MISS-2027-03-OCEAN-03 Green, circular and resilient harbours – Horizon Europe
call_title: Supporting the implementation of the Restore our Ocean and Waters Mission (HORIZON-MISS-2027-03)
call_module_title: HORIZON-MISS-2027-03-OCEAN-03 Green, circular and resilient harbours
executive_summary: Tests sustainability and resilience measures in ports across the four Mission basins, including local strategies for renewable energy, climate adaptation, biodiversity and pollution reduction. Eligible consortia can include port authorities, public administrations and industry partners. The topic budget is EUR 11.90 million, with EUR 5.50–5.95 million expected per project. Opening 2027-02-09. Full proposal deadline 2027-09-21 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Missions Work Programme, pp. 131–134, describes the eligible work in Scope. General Annex B allows a Dutch funded beneficiary, and the scope names industry partners and renewable-energy strategies. TenneT could contribute to an eligible port energy strategy through grid-connection planning in a North Sea demonstrator. This supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are date-helper defaults based on 1 January 2027 and 36 months.
